text: Working with APIs is an essential skill for modern developers. An API allows your program to communicate with another service by sending HTTP requests, usually using methods like GET or POST. The server often responds with data in JSON format, which is easy to read and parse. Before you can access many APIs, you need authentication, such as an API key, to prove your identity. It is also important to respect rate limits, which control how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, always include error handling, because network problems or invalid requests can happen at any time.
